design: Prospectively fixed new-velocity-seed batch testing hypotheses generated from the original three trajectories; not an independently chosen target or starting conformation
expected_dynamics_environment: same Ubuntu GROMACS2026.3 conda-forge CUDA12.9; analysis-only Biopython may be added without changing dynamics binary or libraries
hypothesis: Is an early geometrical deviation with Y3-P19 distance increase seen again in new velocity-seeded trajectories under the same starting configuration?
primary_descriptive_endpoints: per-seed internal CA3-18 independently fitted RMSD across all38 NMR references
per-seed Y3-P19 minimum sidechain-heavy distance and fractions above5/6/7A
Q under original8A/1.2 convention together with the full7/8/9A by1.1/1.2/1.3 sensitivity grid
window_rule: Left-inclusive/right-exclusive except final11ns endpoint included;1-3ns arose from old-data exploration but is fixed before the new data
reference_policy: Report all38 NMR references; no best-reference selection. Excluded contacts explicitly null, never zero occupancy.
episode_definition: Consecutive saved10ps samples strictly above5/6/7A; observed span is last minus first sample, not physical lifetime
inference_policy: No binary success/failure threshold invented after results; report all three trajectories and all frozen endpoints. No frame-level pvalues, convergence, folding-state or causal claims.
comparison_policy: Analyze new batch alone first; compare same windows/metrics against all original three. Report original and new cohorts separately before any descriptive six-run pooling. No selecting a favorable new seed.
stopping_rule: Complete all three11ns, retain outcomes; stop for technical failures. No selective extension or extra seeds based on results.
